name: Lurker Venom
summary: Lurker Venom is a potent natural toxin harvested from the predatory spiders that prowl the rocky hills and woods of Loch Modan. Dwarven defenders require this caustic venom as a key ingredient to prepare an alchemical neutralizing compound against Dark Iron sabotage.

sections.title: A Volatile Reagent
sections.body: The hills and crags surrounding Loch Modan crawl with predatory arachnids—ranging from common wood lurkers to the infamous matriarch Shanda the Spinner. While their bites pose a constant hazard to mountaineers and travelers, Chief Engineer Hinderweir discovered an unconventional use for their virulent poison. Combined with rare minerals and tears harvested from the loch's crocolisks, Lurker Venom forms a reactive solvent capable of disarming complex Dark Iron explosives.

faq.q: Where does Lurker Venom come from?
faq.answer: It is extracted from the various lurker spiders native to Loch Modan, including Cliff Lurkers, Forest Lurkers, Wood Lurkers, and their brood matriarch Shanda the Spinner.

faq.q: What is Lurker Venom used for?
aliases: why do i need lurker venom
what does hinderweir do with venom
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir uses the venom as part of a specialized chemical mixture to neutralize and defuse explosive devices deployed by Dark Iron infiltrators around the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: Why use venom to defuse an explosive?
aliases: how does venom stop dark iron bombs
faq.answer: Dwarven engineers often rely on reactive, acidic, or caustic mixtures to dissolve delicate mechanical components or neutralize unstable blasting powders without detonating them.

faq.q: Is Shanda the Spinner the only source?
aliases: do i have to kill shanda
faq.answer: No. While Shanda carries the venom, any of the common wild lurker spiders inhabiting the woodlands and rocky cliffs of Loch Modan can yield it.

angles.text: Using organic toxins to disable hostile ordinance showcases an improvised, reactive branch of dwarven engineering under battlefield conditions.
Mountaineers and defenders of Loch Modan routinely use local wilderness hazards to protect crucial Khaz Modan infrastructure against the Dark Iron clan.
